summary.text: Asyiqin Sanif is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Murray Plains at the 2026 Victorian election. A retail worker and trade union member, she studied communications at RMIT and attended Echuca College. As an organiser with RMIT Students for Palestine she coordinated a month-long campus encampment in 2024.

summary.text: Brett Hosking is the Nationals candidate for Murray Plains at the 2026 Victorian election, seeking to succeed the retiring former party leader Peter Walsh. A grain grower, he led the Victorian Farmers Federation as its president from December 2024 until June 2026, after more than a decade in senior roles with the farm lobby. His party page says his family has been in the district for five generations.

summary.text: Christine Grundy is Labor's candidate for Murray Plains at the 2026 Victorian election, a seat the Nationals' Peter Walsh is leaving. Her party page says she studied at university without fees under the Whitlam government and went on to work as a water engineer. She has also been a support worker for people with intellectual disability and is now retired.

summary.text: Ewan McDonald is the Family First candidate for Murray Plains at the 2026 Victorian election, on the VEC's list of nominations. The party describes him as a fourth-generation farmer working his family's land near Rochester, a former president of the Young Nationals in Victoria and a former Christian Democratic Party candidate, and says he captained his local CFA brigade for ten years. Wikipedia records him as a Christian Democrats candidate for the Northern Victoria upper-house region in 2006 and 2010, for the Senate in Victoria in 2007 and for Murray at the 2010 federal election.

summary.text: Garner Smith is One Nation's candidate for Murray Plains at the 2026 Victorian election. He has been mayor of Gannawarra Shire since 2024, runs irrigated beef farms and other businesses in the region, and has also worked as an economist. His earlier jobs include electorate officer for Senator Julian McGauran and ministerial adviser to Nationals MP Bill Baxter. One Nation's page for him could not be read for this profile because the site refuses automated requests.

sources.title: Murray Plains: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Peita Collard is the Animal Justice Party's candidate for Murray Plains at the 2026 Victorian election, according to the VEC's list of nominations. Before nominations closed, the party's page and candidate list and the ABC named her for Preston, while Wikipedia listed her for the party's Northern Metropolitan Region ticket. A therapist in private practice, she grew up in Brisbane, moved to Melbourne to work in theatre and later founded an independent theatre company.

prior_roles.role: Founder and leader of an independent theatre company

summary.text: Zoe Cook is the Greens candidate for Murray Plains at the 2026 Victorian election and a councillor on Campaspe Shire Council. She belongs to the Echuca Moama Theatre Company, plays cricket and umpires netball. She says her council work has focused on public transport, housing and the cost of living.
